register: # SolarEdge grid-tied inverters — all models with SetApp configuration or firmware 3.xxxx+
# Models: SE3000H/SE3800/SE4000H/SE5000H/SE5K/SE6000H/SE7K (single-phase)
#   SE10K/SE12.5K/SE15K/SE25K (three-phase) and Synergy multi-phase series
# Interface A: Modbus TCP port 502 (disabled by default; enable in SetApp: Site Communication → Modbus TCP)
# Interface B: Modbus RTU RS485; default 115200 baud 8N1 (configurable 9600-115200 bps)
#   Enable: SetApp → Commissioning → Site Communication → RS485-1 → Protocol → SunSpec (Non-SE Logger)
#   Set RS485-1 → Device ID to unique unit ID (1-247)
# IMPORTANT: SolarEdge supports ONE Modbus master at a time — either RTU or TCP
# Protocol: SunSpec integer + scale factor model (IDs 101/102/103)
# Register addressing: register 40001 = Modbus PDU address 40000 (subtract 1 when coding requests)
# All multi-register values: big-endian (high register first); apply SF register as value x 10^SF
# NaN: int16 = 0x8000; uint16 = 0xFFFF; int32/acc32 = 0x80000000
